title: Second Drink: Email Surveillance with Ken Jeong

sentences.en: Hello, everyone, and welcome to your second drink of email surveillance.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到你们的第二杯“邮件监控”节目。

sentences.en: In our breakdown this week, we have a fantastic interview with Ken Jeong.
sentences.zh: 在本周的解析中，我们请到了肯·郑（Ken Jeong）进行了一场精彩的访谈。

sentences.en: With a pop-in from Joel McHale.
sentences.zh: 乔尔·麦克哈尔（Joel McHale）也来客串了一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, these were the old days when a bunch of us were all recording at the same time.
sentences.zh: 没错，那是我们很多人同时录音的旧时光。

sentences.en: Yes, and then we'd see people going from one podcast to another.
sentences.zh: 是的，那时候我们还会看到大家从一个播客串到另一个播客。

sentences.en: It was a lot of fun.
Well, in this episode, Email Surveillance, we get to see Michael Scott go to his improv class.
sentences.zh: 在这一集《邮件监控》中，我们看到迈克尔·斯科特去上了即兴表演课。

sentences.en: And, you know, when he's in improv class, he turns every scene into a Michael Skarn moment.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当他在即兴表演课上时，他会把每一场戏都变成迈克尔·斯卡恩（Michael Skarn）的时刻。

sentences.en: He pulls out his imaginary gun and he shoots them.
sentences.zh: 他会掏出他的假想枪，然后把他们都射杀。

sentences.en: Well, in his interview, Ken Jeong shared some really fun stuff about shooting all those scenes.
sentences.zh: 在访谈中，肯·郑分享了一些拍摄那些场景时非常有趣的事情。

sentences.en: But I found an interview that Steve did with Janelle Riley for the Screen Actors Foundation,
sentences.zh: 但我找到了史蒂夫（Steve）接受珍妮尔·莱利（Janelle Riley）为演员工会基金会（Screen Actors Foundation）做的采访，

sentences.en: where he explained the inspiration for Michael's character always pulling a gun,
sentences.zh: 他在采访中解释了迈克尔这个角色在即兴表演课上总是掏枪的灵感来源，

sentences.en: It was based on a real person.
sentences.zh: 这是基于一个真实的人。

sentences.en: I know on The Office, Michael Scott was a big fan of improv.
sentences.zh: 我知道在《办公室》里，迈克尔·斯科特是个即兴表演的忠实粉丝。

sentences.en: And his improvs were angry, but he was always pulling a gun.
sentences.zh: 他的即兴表演总是充满愤怒，而且他总是会掏出一把枪。

sentences.en: That's actually, that's based on a friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 那其实是基于我的一个朋友。

sentences.en: There was a guy at Second City who always used to pull a gun during scenes.
sentences.zh: 在第二城市（Second City）剧团有个家伙，他以前在表演时总是会掏枪。

sentences.en: And he'll laugh about it, too.
sentences.zh: 他也会拿这件事开玩笑。

sentences.en: But we actually let him, a scene got into the show in Second City because we all agreed,
sentences.zh: 但我们确实让他演过，有一场戏被放进了第二城市的演出里，因为我们都商量好了，

sentences.en: we're going to let Ron pull the gun and then we're going to let him kill all of us in the scene.
sentences.zh: 我们要让罗恩（Ron）掏枪，然后我们要让他把戏里的我们全都杀掉。

sentences.en: And that's what the scene was.
I mean, it took me back to my improv days.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这让我回想起了我自己的即兴表演时光。

sentences.en: Well, if you're like me and you wanted more scenes from that improv class,
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果你和我一样，想看更多那场即兴表演课的片段，

sentences.en: there are a lot more in deleted scenes.
sentences.zh: 在删减片段里还有很多。

sentences.en: I need to know who shot Johnson.
sentences.zh: 我需要知道是谁杀了约翰逊。

sentences.en: I have a right mind to shoot you right in the head.
sentences.zh: 我真想一枪崩了你的头。

sentences.en: I don't want to hear anything more from you.
No, listen to what she's saying.
I'll be quiet if we can make some kind of deal.
sentences.zh: 如果我们能达成某种交易，我就安静下来。
别想跟FBI的迈克尔·斯卡恩谈。
迈克尔·斯卡恩从不交易。

sentences.en: Michael Skarn shoots and then asks questions later.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·斯卡恩只管开枪，事后再问话。

sentences.en: Michael Skarn is now alone on stage because he no longer has any scene partners.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·斯卡恩现在独自站在舞台上，因为他已经没有搭档了。

sentences.en: I re-watched all these deleted scenes too.
sentences.zh: 我也把这些删减片段全重看了一遍。

sentences.en: And after that moment, he gets in this whole argument with the teacher and the student about how she wasn't doing the scene right.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，他和老师还有学生吵了一架，说她演得不对。

sentences.en: The teacher is trying to like gently suggest that that could have gone another way.
sentences.zh: 老师试图委婉地建议，说那场戏其实可以有别的演法。

sentences.en: And Michael's like, well, it could have gone another way if we wanted to do it not funny, basically.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔就说，如果我们不想演得好笑，那确实可以有别的演法。

sentences.en: He's like such a horrible scene partner.
Well, there is another deleted scene, which they actually added to the superfan episode where the teacher tells everyone to partner up.
sentences.zh: 对了，还有一个删减片段，被加进了超级粉丝版剧集里，老师让大家两两分组。

sentences.en: But no one wants to partner with Michael.
sentences.zh: 但没人想和迈克尔一组。

sentences.en: He just, well, why would they?
sentences.zh: 他就是……好吧，谁会想跟他一组呢？

sentences.en: So he just keeps shouting out suggestions and then the teacher keeps suggesting, you know what, why don't you take a break?
sentences.zh: 所以他不停地大喊建议，老师就一直劝他，你知道吗，要不你先休息一下？

sentences.en: All of these scenes, you know, brought me back to my improv days.
sentences.zh: 所有这些片段，让我回想起了我即兴表演的日子。

sentences.en: I mean, I feel like I've shared with you how we had one guy who would steamroll every scene he was in.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我好像跟你们分享过，我们当时有个家伙，不管演什么戏都要强行主导。

sentences.en: So we all just made a pact that in every scene we'd find a way to kill him.
sentences.zh: 所以我们大家私下约定，在每一场戏里都要想办法“杀掉”他。

sentences.en: Oh, you were Michael Skarning him.
sentences.zh: 噢，你们是在对他进行“迈克尔·斯卡恩式”对待啊。

sentences.en: But you would, everyone got so creative.
sentences.zh: 但你们真的，每个人都变得好有创意。

sentences.en: There were blow darts, attack of a killer cat.
sentences.zh: 有吹箭，还有杀人猫袭击。

sentences.en: Well, you know, this is also the episode where Jim is throwing a party at his house and Michael finds out that he's not invited.
sentences.zh: 对了，这一集里吉姆在家里办派对，迈克尔发现自己没被邀请。

sentences.en: There's actually a lot of discussion about who is invited and who is going.
sentences.zh: 关于谁被邀请了、谁要去参加，其实有很多讨论。

sentences.en: And Angela, in our breakdown, you mentioned how at five minutes and 57 seconds, we see the invite on Michael's computer.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，在我们的解析里，你提到在5分57秒时，我们看到了迈克尔电脑上的邀请函。

sentences.en: If you look closely, you can see that the Evite says 14 people have said yes to the Evite and two have not replied.
sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看，可以看到电子邀请函上显示有14人确认参加，2人未回复。

sentences.en: Now, we can only see who said yes, but Pam is not on the liSt.
sentences.zh: 现在我们只能看到谁确认了，但名单里没有帕姆。

sentences.en: But Pam has not confirmed her attendance.
sentences.zh: 但帕姆确实还没确认出席。

sentences.en: Well, lady, I found another nugget that might explain why Pam hasn't RSVP'd yet.
sentences.zh: 好吧，女士，我发现了另一个可能解释为什么帕姆还没回复的小细节。

sentences.en: I wonder if it's because she didn't know she was RSVPing for one or two people.
sentences.zh: 我在想是不是因为她不知道该按一个人还是两个人的名额回复。

sentences.en: When we broke down this episode, we were speculating why Roy wasn't at Jim's barbecue.
sentences.zh: 我们解析这一集时，还在猜测为什么罗伊没去吉姆的烧烤派对。

sentences.en: Well, the reason Roy doesn't go is a deleted scene, and it was added to the superfan episode.
sentences.zh: 其实罗伊没去的原因在一个删减片段里，它被加进了超级粉丝版剧集。

sentences.en: Um, I was wondering if it might be okay if I go to Lonnie's poker game tonight.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我在想，今晚我能不能去参加朗尼的扑克局？

sentences.en: I promise it'll be like the last time for a while.
sentences.zh: 我保证这会是近期最后一次了。

sentences.en: We're supposed to go to the barbecue at Jim's house.
sentences.zh: 我们本来要去吉姆家参加烧烤聚会的。

sentences.en: Um, could you go without me?
Make something up, say I'm like, ate something, or...
sentences.zh: 随便编个理由，就说我吃了什么不舒服之类的，或者……

sentences.en: Okay, don't wake me up, because I'm playing ball in the morning.
sentences.zh: 行，别叫醒我，因为我明天早上还要打球。

sentences.en: How he like butters her up before he ditches her for the night?
sentences.zh: 他为了晚上能溜出去，是怎么哄她的？

sentences.en: And he has to play ball in the morning.
sentences.zh: 而且他明天早上还得打球。

sentences.en: He's got a lot going on.
And none of it is with Pam.
sentences.zh: 而且没一件是陪帕姆的。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, that is your second drink for today.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，这是你们今天的第二杯酒了。

sentences.en: And now, here is email surveillance.
sentences.zh: 现在，进入邮件监控环节。

sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演过《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now, we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你带来《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会解析一集《办公室》，并分享独家幕后故事，

sentences.en: stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 这些故事只有我们这两个亲历者才能告诉你。

sentences.en: To the email surveillance episode of Office Ladies.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《办公室女士》之邮件监控那一集。

sentences.en: It is Season 2, Episode 9, written by Jen Salata, directed by Paul Feig.
sentences.zh: 这是第二季第九集，由简·萨拉塔编剧，保罗·费格执导。

sentences.en: And we have a special guest in the studio with us today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们演播室里有一位特别嘉宾。

sentences.en: He played Bill, one of the members of Michael Scott's improv class.
sentences.zh: 他饰演了比尔，迈克尔·斯科特即兴表演课的成员之一。

sentences.en: It is our friend, Kin Jong!
sentences.zh: 他就是我们的朋友，金·钟！

sentences.en: Thank you so much for having me.
We are so excited you are here.
You are our second in-studio gueSt.
sentences.zh: 你是我们第二位演播室嘉宾。
你和克里德·布拉顿（Creed Bratton）在一起，金。

sentences.en: So, I'm very, very excited to be here.
sentences.zh: 所以我非常、非常高兴能来到这里。

sentences.en: Congrats on the success of your podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你们的播客大获成功。

sentences.en: I listen to it, and it's awesome.
So, thank you for having me.
And this is Kin's day off.
sentences.zh: 而且今天是金的休息日。

sentences.en: And, I mean, you're a busy, busy person.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你是个大忙人。

sentences.en: I can't even get into the Masked Singer and what it means to my children and how much we
sentences.zh: 我甚至还没法细说《蒙面歌王》对我孩子们意味着什么，以及我们

sentences.en: But you're a busy guy, and we appreciate you coming in on your day off.
sentences.zh: 但你是个大忙人，我们很感激你在休息日还特意赶来。

sentences.en: Before we get into this episode, you two have known each other for a very long time.
sentences.zh: 在进入这集节目之前，你们俩认识很久了。

sentences.en: When did you guys become friends?
sentences.zh: 你们是什么时候成为朋友的？

sentences.en: I think, really, Kin, what crystallized our friendship was your 40th birthday.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，金，真正让我们友谊升华的是你的40岁生日。

sentences.en: So, he's twisting in his chair right now.
sentences.zh: 你看，他现在在椅子上坐立难安呢。

sentences.en: He literally is about to fall out of his chair.
sentences.zh: 他简直快从椅子上掉下来了。

sentences.en: So, you know, Kin had done The Office, but we didn't work together that day.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，金当时演过《办公室》，但那天我们没一起工作。

sentences.en: And then, years later, we're on hiatus from The Office, and I am going to be playing this
sentences.zh: 后来，几年后，我们《办公室》剧组在休假，我当时要出演

sentences.en: role on a movie called Furry Vengeance.
sentences.zh: 一部叫《毛茸茸的复仇》的电影。
波姬·小丝（Brooke Shields）也参演了。

sentences.en: I was such a huge Brendan Fraser fan.
sentences.zh: 我当时可是布兰登·费舍的超级粉丝。

sentences.en: We were filming in the middle of nowhere, Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 我们当时在马萨诸塞州一个偏僻的地方拍摄。

sentences.en: Day one, I think we were, like, two doors apart on our floor.
sentences.zh: 第一天，我想我们住在同一层楼，只隔了两扇门。

sentences.en: I think we were across from each other.
sentences.zh: 我想我们当时坐在彼此对面。

sentences.en: I come out of my room, Kin comes out, and I'm like, hey, you picked the Radisson, too.
sentences.zh: 我走出房间，金也走出来，我就说，嘿，你也选了丽笙酒店啊。

sentences.en: We're the only two actors in the Radisson with the crew.
sentences.zh: 我们是丽笙酒店里唯二和剧组住在一起的演员。

sentences.en: So, we just would hang out all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们总是待在一起。

sentences.en: We were always in the shuttle together.
We became pretty fast friends right away.
sentences.zh: 我们很快就成了好朋友。

sentences.en: And that first week was Kin's 40th birthday, and here he is away from his family.
sentences.zh: 第一周正好是金的40岁生日，他当时离家在外。

sentences.en: You were a little sad about it.
And we didn't have a car because we were on location.
sentences.zh: 因为我们在外景地，所以没有车。

sentences.en: Our day off happened to be his birthday together, him and I.
sentences.zh: 我们的休息日正好赶上他的生日，我和他在一起。

sentences.en: I'm going to take you out for your birthday.
And from the Radisson, we were sort of up on a hill, and you could see down the hill,
sentences.zh: 丽笙酒店建在山上，你可以俯瞰山下，

sentences.en: down a big, steep hill in this parking lot was a P.F.
sentences.zh: 在山下那个又大又陡的坡底，停车场里有一家P.F.

sentences.en: And I said, Ken, I'm taking you to P.F.
I don't know why we didn't want to get a cab.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么我们当时不想打车。

sentences.en: And we walked it, and it wasn't like it was connected in the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 我们走着去的，而且那地方并不是连着停车场的。

sentences.en: At one point, we had to crawl a little bit through a grassy median thing.
sentences.zh: 有一段路我们还得爬过中间的一小片草地。

sentences.en: It was like the parking lot was separated by a little bit of a grassy knoll.
sentences.zh: 停车场中间隔着一个小土坡。

sentences.en: Anyway, we walked down this parking lot.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们走下了那个停车场。
我们在上午11点左右进了P.F.

sentences.en: We ate so much and drank a ton of beer, and we were both really buzzed.
sentences.zh: 我们吃了很多，喝了一大堆啤酒，两个人都喝高了。

sentences.en: And now we have to walk up this hill, and we're like tipsy, and we're like, oh, my God, this
sentences.zh: 然后我们得走上那个坡，我们当时醉醺醺的，心想，天哪，这

sentences.en: hill sucks on the way back.
And Ken was like, what did you do to me?
sentences.zh: 金当时就说，你对我做了什么？

sentences.en: Okay, you just decided mid-walk, like, hey, I should just exercise.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你走到一半突然决定，嘿，我该锻炼一下。

sentences.en: And you're like walking around the parking lot like you're doing laps.
sentences.zh: 然后你就开始在停车场里绕圈，像是在跑圈一样。

sentences.en: I said, pump your arms, Ken.
And then we're literally speedwalking drunk at a Radisson parking lot.
sentences.zh: 然后我们就真的在丽笙酒店的停车场里醉醺醺地竞走。

sentences.en: Just remember, you're just, there's a hill.
sentences.zh: 你只要记住，那里有个坡。

sentences.en: I was like, Ken, pump your arMs.
sentences.zh: 我当时说，金，摆动你的手臂。

sentences.en: We're going to get a workout.
And I was just crying laughing.
sentences.zh: 我当时笑得眼泪都出来了。

sentences.en: You were crying laughing so hard.
sentences.zh: 你当时笑得太厉害了，眼泪都出来了。

sentences.en: You were like, what are we doing?
sentences.zh: 你当时就像是说，我们到底在干什么？

sentences.en: Okay, I'm taking us off topic.

sentences.zh: 在这一集中，迈克尔获取了所有人的邮件访问权限，并发现吉姆正在举办一场

sentences.en: Everyone except Michael has been invited.
sentences.zh: 除了迈克尔，所有人都收到了邀请。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔气急败坏，但吉姆坚持不邀请他。

sentences.zh: 在参加完每周的即兴表演课后，迈克尔还是闯入了烧烤派对，并且

sentences.zh: 帕姆怀疑德怀特和安吉拉可能在谈恋爱。

sentences.zh: 我们总是从速览事实开始，肯。

sentences.zh: 嗯，珍娜很喜欢速览事实。

sentences.zh: 我也喜欢，但感觉就像是你创造了“速览事实”这个词一样。

sentences.zh: 噢，乔尔·麦克哈尔在对你竖中指。

sentences.zh: 我们的听众需要一些背景信息吗？

sentences.zh: 这是乔尔·麦克哈尔，我在《废柴联盟》里的死对头。

sentences.zh: 我们现在在一个录音棚里，玻璃窗正对着他的录音棚。

sentences.zh: 我们可以透过玻璃看到他，他也能看到我们，他现在表现得很无礼且具有攻击性。

sentences.zh: 他向我们竖了中指，然后还露屁股羞辱我们。

sentences.zh: 我是来找我深爱和崇拜的人的。

sentences.en: Guys, my favorite Parks and Rec episode.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，我最喜欢的《公园与游憩》剧集。

sentences.en: This is the show that started it all.
sentences.zh: 这可是开创了这一切的剧集。

sentences.en: And as much as Angela and Jenna are best friends, you and I, if we had a show, we would call
sentences.zh: 虽然安吉拉和珍娜是最好的朋友，但你和我，如果我们有个节目，我们会称

sentences.zh: 自己为“社区公敌”，因为我以前不喜欢你。
